-- Prueba: Evaluación matemática sobre texto sucio (coerción de strings numéricos con comas)
SELECT 
    ".country-name" AS name, 
    ".country-capital" AS capital, 
    ".country-population" AS population,
    ".country-area" AS area
FROM "scrapethissite.com/pages/simple/" 
ROWS ".country" 
WHERE population > 50000000 AND area > 1000000
ORDER BY population DESC;
